checks.why: control: with no bounds the file walk goes both ways, so a declaration's caller and its callee are both listed
direction callers follows calls backward only: who calls send_receipt, and who calls that, never what it calls
direction callees follows calls forward only: what send_receipt calls, never who calls it
depth bounds the file walk: one hop back reaches the direct caller and stops before the caller's caller
depth bounds the flow too: one hop from checkout is its own call, not the calls beneath it
the flow follows calls forward, so a walk asked to go only backward tells no flow
